haiku-low.q1: Held 10 minutes for one order. If the order has not claimed it by then, the stock goes back on sale.
haiku-low.q2: Stock is reserved before the charge. If any line is short, nothing is reserved or charged; the order becomes REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK and the customer is told which items.
haiku-low.q3: The order id is sent as the idempotency key and charge reference. A retry with the same key returns the existing payment record, so no second charge happens.
haiku-low.q4: Payment is refunded in full via RefundRequested, the order becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK, and the customer is emailed. No partial orders are shipped.
haiku-low.q5: The Cart service clears the cart only when it consumes OrderConfirmed. If checkout fails before that, the cart stays exactly as it was.
haiku-low.q6: The Order service drives the sequence and owns the status. Its stored orders hold the record of how far each checkout has got.
haiku-low.q7: The provider sends a webhook to Payment, which publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentDeclined on the broker. Order subscribes and finishes the order.
haiku-low.q8: Payment stores provider event ids with a unique constraint and ignores repeats. Order acts on a payment event only if the order is AWAITING_PAYMENT.
haiku-low.q9: Order sets PAYMENT_DECLINED and tries once to ask Inventory to release the hold, triggered by the declined event. If release fails, the hold expires after 10 minutes.
haiku-low.q10: During the claim, Inventory checks the hold. If it lapsed, it tries to re-reserve all lines; if stock is still there the order is confirmed, otherwise it is refunded and cancelled.
haiku-low.q11: The refund stays PENDING and is retried until it succeeds. Repeated failure raises an alert for a person. It is tracked in a refund record in the Payment database.
haiku-low.q12: OrderConfirmed causes the cart to be cleared. The Cart service consumes it and clears the whole cart.

sonnet.q1: 10 minutes. If the order has not claimed it by then, the stock goes back on sale (hold lapses).
sonnet.q2: Stock is reserved before charging. If any line is short, nothing is reserved, no payment is requested, order becomes REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK, customer is told which items are short, cart unchanged.
sonnet.q3: The order id is used as idempotency key (and charge reference) on the provider charge request and on calls to Inventory and Payment; a repeated call does what the first did, and Payment returns the existing payment record, so no second charge.
sonnet.q4: Money is refunded in full (Order publishes RefundRequested; Payment refunds the full amount at the provider). Order becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK and the customer is emailed.
sonnet.q5: Cart is cleared only when Cart consumes OrderConfirmed (after CONFIRMED). On any failure before CONFIRMED the cart stays exactly as it was.
sonnet.q6: The Order service drives the sequence. The record of progress is the order's status stored in the Order service's database (only Order changes statuses).
sonnet.q7: Provider calls a webhook on Payment; Payment publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentDeclined (with order id) as an event on the broker; Order subscribes and handles it, then finishes the order.
sonnet.q8: Duplicate webhooks: Payment checks the provider event id (stored, unique constraint) and ignores repeats. Repeated events: Order acts only if the order is AWAITING_PAYMENT, so repeats do nothing; claim calls are idempotent by order id; outbox resends until accepted and consumers ignore repeats.
sonnet.q9: Order sets PAYMENT_DECLINED upon receiving the PaymentDeclined event and tries once to ask Inventory to release the hold. If that fails, the hold expires after 10 minutes.
sonnet.q10: On success, Order asks Inventory to claim the hold. If the hold lapsed, Inventory tries one all-or-nothing re-reserve of every line. If that works, order is CONFIRMED; if stock is gone, order is CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK with a full refund.
sonnet.q11: The refund stays PENDING and is retried until it succeeds; repeated failure alerts a person. It is tracked in the refund record in the Payment DB (order status does not change).
sonnet.q12: The Order service publishes OrderConfirmed when the order is CONFIRMED; the Cart service consumes it and clears the whole cart.
